text:
|| samadānādibhirbhedairupāyairvā pṛthagvidhaiḥ | na tu yuddhena sarvathā || tathā ca | yāvad eva na saṃgrāmaṃ yāvad eva na śatrubalam | paśyanti garvitāḥ sarve tāvad eva hi vīrāḥ || tathā ca | na tathā jāyate yuddhaṃ prāṇināṃ yat prakīrtitam | na ca svalpāyasaḥ svalpaṃ phalaṃ bhavati kasyacit || tathāpi yuddhe samupasthite sati tatra avajñā kartavyā | yataḥ |

yuddhe samupasthite cakravāka āha | bho rājan na prathamaṃ yuddhaṃ kartavyam | yato na sa bhṛtyo na sa mantrī yo rājānaṃ prathamaṃ yuddhe pravartayati svasthānād vā vinā vicāreṇa cyāvayati | tathā ca | samādibhirupāyairripuṃ jetuṃ prayateta na tu yuddhena | yataḥ saṃgrāme dvayorapi vijayo na niścitaḥ | tathā ca | samadānādibhirbhedairupāyairvā pṛthagvidhaiḥ | sarvathā yatnamāsthāya na tu yuddhena sādhayet ||
